title: Dumbbells Only
author: Yasmin C.
desc: A full-body strength workout that needs nothing but a pair of dumbbells, so it works at home, in a hotel gym, or on a packed gym day. It opens with lower-body compound lifts (goblet squats and Romanian deadlifts) for the quads, glutes, and hamstrings. Then it moves through upper-body pushing and pulling with bent-over rows, standing shoulder presses, and floor presses, and finishes with arm and shoulder isolation work: bicep curls, overhead tricep extensions, and lateral raises. It's a balanced, no-frills session that builds strength and muscle head to toe with minimal equipment.
